The speaker explicitly calls it '당X 회복 오일' (Diabetes Recovery Oil) and highlights its '항산화 성분' (antioxidant components) that protect the pancreas. Search results confirm that '블랙커민 오일' is widely recognized for its benefits related to blood sugar regulation and pancreatic health, aligning with the claims made in the video. Although no specific brand is mentioned in the video, '블랙커민 오일' is the clear product being promoted. The landing page candidates are chosen based on reputable sites selling black cumin oil, particularly those mentioning its health benefits relevant to the video's claims.
